title: Married With Secrets
description:
S01 E07 — Obsession Has Its Price
Bill Douglas is a respected doctor at Tufts University in Boston, but he becomes obsessed with a prostitute he met in a red-light district known as the Combat Zone; together, they lead double lives ending in murder.

title: Married With Secrets
description:
S01 E05 — Fear the Ether Man
A serial rapist known as the Ether Man lurks in the shadows of Albuquerque, N.M., and victims cannot identify the masked attacker; while the offender expands his hunting grounds, officials work to stop him before he attacks again.

title: Married With Secrets
description:
S01 E08 — The Mastermind
LAPD investigators are on the hunt for a criminal stealing expensive yachts, but what they find instead is a mild-mannered man among their own ranks.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:
S11 E02 — Renovation Rage
A family moves one house over and closer to neighbors they've been friendly with for years; however, things go sour when they start renovations; the noise and waste ignite a vicious feud, ending in a frenzy of bullets and bloodshed.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:
S11 E05 — Get Off My Property
When a large and boisterous family moves to a quiet street, the neighbors directly across from them get into immediate conflict over all the noise; soon the dispute consumes everyone and is only settled with the deadly crack of a baseball bat.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:
S09 E06 — Bones of Contention
Two neighbors who are down on their luck bond over their struggle; when one buries the other in debt with a hustle gone wrong, things fall apart, but their co-dependence keeps them entwined until an act of revenge.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:

A couple moves to the country and ruins the quiet their new neighbors have enjoyed for years; parties, loud kids, and a junk-strewn lawn push the Vietnam vet next door to build a fence, but violence boils over when property lines are disputed.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:
S10 E01 — Hillbilly Holler
A bachelor is welcomed into a neighborhood, but things go south when he starts disputing the property lines; the warring parties film each other extensively, but the cameras aren't running when violence erupts.

title: Fear Thy Neighbor
description:

When a single man buys a home in a rural community, he becomes fast friends with his neighbor until a minor parking issue sets them at odds; police are soon summoned for everything from horse manure to death threats.

title: Fatal Vows
description:

Everyone is happy when Miranda marries Sam because she's pretty and he's cute and friendly, but Miranda's spending veers out of control and tears the couple apart until one of them looks outside the marriage and finds nothing short of murder.

title: Does Murder Sleep?
description:

title: Evil Lives Here: Shadows of Death

title: Evil Lives Here: Shadows of Death

title: Signs of a Psychopath

title: Signs of a Psychopath

title: Signs of a Psychopath
